scope: Selected released bytecode, source hashes and independent callback interpretation. Not a live fight, final attribute calculation or runtime performance measurement.

findings.klobber: Expanded AABB by11, vulnerable non-sneaking players get horizontal signum velocity*0.019; selected override has no explicit server-only guard.
findings.proshield: After superclass damage returns true, melee-classified incoming damage triggers mob damage amount/2 against the immediate source. This is the incoming method argument, not a measured final health-loss fraction.
findings.mirage: Server living-update callback nextInt80==0; in Immortallis choose one of4 fixed positions. Independent random trials, not a guaranteed80-tick timer.
findings.flash: Melee-classified incoming damage can teleport on server before superclass acceptance. Successful outgoing melee invokes doMeleeEffect, which also teleports. Constructor slippery flag and AI-speed argument are not blocks-per-second measurements.

limits: Base values may be modified by configuration, difficulty, attributes and other mods.
AABB expansion is not a radial11-block sphere.
No claim that damage classified as ranged bypasses every inherited immunity.
Source-derived tactics must still be tested in the target port.
